assessment: Initial SP half-node performance and memory assessment
scope: One workload, one logical block size, one tile setting, two reversed process groups. No tuning or production-code changes.

protocol.precision: single only; ENABLE_DOUBLE_PRECISION=OFF in all eight builds
protocol.build: Release, -O3 -Mrecursive; GPU builds additionally -gpu=cc80; static libraries, FIAT/FIELD_API/NVTX/ROCTX off
protocol.inline_library: Disabled consistently, including benchmark-only CMake changes in older sources. Compiler automatic inlining remains enabled. No build uses -Mextract or -Minline=lib.
protocol.controlled_inputs: ENABLE_BITIDENTITY_TESTING=ON; prescribed input radii, overlap and seeds
protocol.physics: Common RRTMG/McICA configuration from ci-debug/benchmark-nvhpc/config.nam; common data directory, aerosols, clear sky, LW derivatives and spectral diagnostics. Native McICA for the main/current CPU pair; McICA ACC for GPU comparisons and the additional matched CPU control.
protocol.cpu_allocation: 64 verified physical AMD EPYC 7742 cores, 64 OpenMP threads; half of a 128-physical-core node
protocol.gpu_allocation: Two distinct NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB GPUs; independent processes each receive 8480 contiguous input columns and 32 physical host cores, with one physics host thread per process
protocol.affinity: srun --cpu-bind=cores; explicit per-task GPU binding; physical-core counts and distinct active GPU UUIDs asserted
protocol.statistic: Median of the two process-group medians. Each group median uses three post-warmup iterations; GPU iteration time is the maximum of the two rank times.
protocol.timed_region: Synchronized full radiation iteration, including per-iteration transfers/gather/scatter as implemented. Excludes setup, initial blocking, NetCDF I/O and process launch. Resident-field setup in the ACC tiled fork is outside the timed region; it is not the same ownership/transfer strategy as the bounded integration path.
protocol.host_memory: GNU time maximum RSS over each complete process lifetime; report maximum across groups of the sum of rank peaks, not a simultaneous whole-node peak
protocol.gpu_memory: NVML per-process device-memory samples every 20 ms over the complete process lifetime, including CUDA context; report maximum across groups of the sum of rank peaks. Transient sub-20-ms peaks can be missed.
protocol.device_stack_override: None in performance runs; no sanitizer instrumentation

jobs.discarded_pilot: 35923948: main's namelist did not accept nwarmup and Slurm inherited an incorrect GPU-per-task binding. Cancelled, harness corrected, and all primary cases rerun. No pilot timing is used.

omp-fork-large-block.execution: OMP tiled-fork revision, batching disabled, NPROMA=1024; working equivalent-call-width control, not a logical-NPROMA=32 tiled baseline

cpu_vs_main.interpretation: Small observed timing increase, no material host-memory change in this initial sample

acc_untiled_vs_master_acc.interpretation: No timing degradation observed, but baseline fluxes differ materially; timing context rather than validated equal-output speedup

acc_tiled_vs_acc_fork.interpretation: Clear end-to-end tiled-path regression versus the fork; transfer/ownership strategies and remaining optimizations differ. Initial data do not isolate the cause.

omp_tiled_vs_equivalent_width_fork_contr.interpretation: Modest gap to a valid 1024-column-call control on the same node; includes packing/orchestration differences and is not a valid comparison against the fork's broken tiled path

numerical_observations.wide_input_cpu_tolerance: The GPU/CPU LW difference exceeds the small-regression-case threshold of 0.001 W/m2 on this larger input; SW passes 0.1 W/m2. This performance assessment does not establish full-domain CPU/device correctness.
numerical_observations.omp_tiled_fork_rejection: The K=32 tiled fork produced near-zero LW and zero TOA SW fluxes: maximum errors against matched CPU about 352.7962 W/m2 LW and 113.5916 W/m2 SW. Its 0.09744 s result is excluded from valid speedup/degradation conclusions. The same revision's NPROMA=1024 per-block fallback matches the integration's tiled outputs exactly.

artifacts.build_commands: module load cmake ninja prgenv/nvidia nvidia/24.5 netcdf4 python3; python3 build/perf-sp/build.py

follow_up_priorities: Explain the ACC tiled-path gap and the approximately fixed additional 226 MiB device peak per GPU before making broader performance claims.
Investigate the upstream OMP fork's broken packed-input path separately; do not use its fast near-zero-flux run as a baseline.
Investigate the larger-input LW CPU/device discrepancy with matched sampling and unchanged tolerances.
